questions.question:
Choose the correct sentence: 
I have _______ to the cinema since I was five years old.
I have _______ to the cinema for five years.
I have _______ to the cinema since five years ago.
I have _______ to the cinema for a long time.
options: I have been going to the cinema since I was five years old.
I have gone to the cinema since I was five years old.
I have been going to the cinema for five years.
I have gone to the cinema for five years.
questions.answer: I have been going to the cinema since I was five years old.

questions.question: Which sentence correctly uses the present perfect tense?
options: She has lived in London for five years.
She lives in London for five years.
She is living in London for five years.
She will live in London for five years.
questions.answer: She has lived in London for five years.

questions.question:
Complete the sentence with the correct form of the verb.
If it _______ rain, we would go for a walk.
If it rains, we will go for a walk.
If it had rained, we would have gone for a walk.
If it were to rain, we would go for a walk.
Which modal verb is used to express strong obligation?

Choose the correct option to complete the sentence.
After _______ the interview, I felt more confident.
After interviewing, I felt more confident.
After interviewed, I felt more confident.
After to interview, I felt more confident.
After being interviewed, I felt more confident.

Select the correct comparative form.
My brother is _______ than me.
My brother is taller than I.
My brother is taller than me.
My brother is more taller than me.
My brother is tallest than me.
Which sentence correctly uses the gerund or infinitive?
options: I prefer swimming in the sea rather than swimming in a pool.
I prefer to swim in the sea rather than to swim in a pool.
I prefer swimming in the sea rather than to swim in a pool.
I prefer to swim in the sea rather than swimming in a pool.
questions.answer: I prefer swimming in the sea rather than swimming in a pool.

questions.question:
Choose the best connector to link the sentences.
He was very tired. _______ , he decided to go to bed.
However,
Therefore,
Nevertheless,
Moreover

Which word is a synonym for 'opportunity' in this context?
She saw a rare opportunity to visit the museum.
Chance, 
Excuse, 
Reason, 
Excuse

Select the correct option to complete the sentence.
By the time I arrived, the train _______.
has left,
left,
was leaving,
had left
